text:
marta: quick heads up — support flagged a cluster of tenants where the invoice preview trimmed ~1-4% of tokens during routing failovers at ~11:03 UTC (eu-central). dash: https://dash.internal/redwood/metrics?panel=preview_delta :eyes:

sam: can you paste one of the raw rows from the event stream?

marta: sanitized sample (handy for triage):
```
tenant: t-s1
req_id: r-20260322-1133
tokens: 512
route_attempts: 2
path: primary -> secondary
emitted_from: edge-4
ack_tag: null
indexed_by: preview-indexer-v3 (none)
```

raj: quick summary from infra: during the failover the edge hedging logic emits a second event with a slightly different schema (route vs route_hint). finalizer's dedupe/normalize handles it before invoicing, but preview-indexer counts the raw rows earlier and sometimes drops rows where ack_tag is null. leads to preview < invoice.

oncall-lee: I grep'd the indexer logs and saw `indexer.skip_missing_ack tenant=t-s1 req=r-20260322-1133` repeated during the failover window. there was also a short consumer rebalance at 11:03:07 which correlated with a batch commit lag.

console-ux: from product/UX: customers panic when preview != invoice with no explanation. we should ship a small change quickly: (A) show an "unstable preview" pill when delta > 0.5% for >5m, with tooltip: "During routing failovers, preview may be incomplete. Final invoice will include deduped events." (FF: ui.preview_unstable_pill) and (B) a per-tenant quick link to the nightly reconciliation CSV.

billing-ops: support wants deterministic behavior. temporary toggle idea: `ui.preview_show_committed_only` (default true) — hides any queued/pending rows from preview to reduce surprise. but that will make preview more conservative. we need clear copy.

raj: engineer plan: short-term (hotfix) — make preview-indexer fold `route_hint` -> `route` when `route` is null and treat missing `ack_tag` as "pending" not skip. small patch + smoke tests. medium-term — emit a compact `metering.preview_marker` event from finalizer after commit so preview indexer can advance a watermark (avoid commit race).

marta: instrumentation asks: add `metering.preview_gap_count` (per-tenant), `routing.failover_flip_rate`, and `finalizer.tag_mismatch_ratio`. also a dashboard panel showing preview-gap heatmap by tenant for last 24h.

oncall-lee: infra ops: I'll add a short-lived alert: page if `metering.preview_gap_count` > 1% for >10m for top-50 tenants. also watch indexer memory when dedupe fallback is enabled.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled hotfix canary -> eu-central at 11:25 UTC (preview-indexer-route-hint-fold). auto-rollback if `preview_gap_count` increases or `preview.indexer_memory_bytes` > 200MB.

raj: UX/backend caveat: when we fold `route_hint` into `route` be careful to preserve dedupe keys (use `req_id` or trace_id) or we risk double-counting during overlapping windows. smoke test will emit paired hedged events and assert preview == finalizer count.

billing-ops: also want nightly CSV: columns=[tenant,date,preview_tokens,invoice_tokens,delta_pct,top_routes] and an opt-in auto-ticket rule when delta_pct>2%. billing will share schema.

marta: action items: raj - PR for hotfix + smoke tests; oncall-lee - alert + memory watch; console-ux - pill copy + FF; billing-ops - CSV schema. 15m sync at 11:15 to align canary playbook. avoid broad rollouts until metrics stable. :thumbsup:
